title: Lithium Americas Publishes 2025 ESG-S Report
summary: (All amounts in US$ unless otherwise indicated) Lithium Americas Corp. (TSX: LAC) (NYSE: LAC) (“ Lithium Americas ” or the “ Company ”) has published its annual environmental, social, governance and safety (“ ESG-S ”) report (“ Report ”) for the period January 1 to December 31, 2025.
